# Configuration

A problem is configured by `omega.toml` in its directory. Every key except the required ones in `[problem]` has a default; unknown keys are an error. Paths are relative to the problem directory.

## `[problem]`

What to optimize and how to describe it to the model.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | required | problem name, used in reports |
| `language` | str | required | "python" \| "cpp" \| "c" |
| `initial` | str | required | initial program, relative to the problem directory |
| `description` | str | `""` | the task, shown in every prompt |
| `metrics_help` | str | `""` | explains the evaluator's metrics to the LLM |
| `hints` | str | `""` | human expert hints, literature pointers |
| `candidate_name` | str | `""` | filename inside the job dir; default = basename of initial |
| `category` | str | `""` | groups the example in the documentation's example gallery |
| `summary` | str | `""` | one sentence on the problem, for the documentation's start page |
| `background` | str | `""` | plain-language background for the example's documentation page: where the problem comes from, what the starting program does and why it is hard; not sent to the model |
| `context_files` | list of strings | `[]` | fixed files shown read-only in every prompt (e.g. a separately compiled harness) |

## `[evaluator]`

How candidates are built, run and scored.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | list of strings | `["{python}", "evaluate.py", "{candidate}"]` | evaluator command, run in the problem directory once per stage |
| `stages` | list[stage] | 1 default entry | cascade, cheapest first |
| `build` | list of strings | `[]` | e.g. ["clang++", "-O3", "{candidate}", "-o", "{binary}"] |
| `build_timeout` | float | `120.0` | seconds before the build is killed |
| `compile` | list of strings | `[]` | separate compilation (instead of build): compile only the candidate to {object} ... |
| `link` | list of strings | `[]` | ... then link {object} with the fixed harness sources into {binary} |
| `exports` | list of strings | `[]` | global symbols the candidate's object may define (its interface, e.g. ["sort_u32"]); anything else global is rejected before linking, so it cannot replace functions the harness or the C library provide. Requires compile and link. |
| `launcher` | list of strings | `[]` | prefix for every job, e.g. ["srun", "-n1"] |
| `concurrency` | int | `4` | evaluation jobs in parallel |
| `sandbox` | bool or none | none | confine jobs: no network, writes only in the job dir (macOS sandbox-exec, Linux bubblewrap, Windows AppContainers); None = on where available |
| `isolate` | bool or none | none | run the candidate (Python module, or compiled program) in its own process that cannot read the problem directory; the evaluator reaches it through omega_transform.harness. None = on for Python, C and C++ |
| `max_memory_mb` | float | `4096.0` | kill a job whose process tree uses more; 0 = no limit |
| `confirm_runs` | int | `0` | extra evaluations of an apparent new best; its score = median |
| `keep_jobs` | bool | `false` | keep job directories for debugging |
| `python` | str | the running interpreter | interpreter for {python}; default: the one running the engine |

## `[[evaluator.stages]]`

One cascade stage; stages run in order.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | `"main"` | stage name, passed as {stage} |
| `args` | list of strings | `[]` | extra arguments appended to the command |
| `timeout` | float | `120.0` | seconds before the stage is killed |
| `min_score` | float or none | none | cascade gate: below this, later stages are skipped |
| `exclusive` | bool | `false` | run alone (no other evaluation in parallel), e.g. timing runs |

## `[llm]`

The model server and models.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | str | `"ollama"` | "ollama" (local), "openai" (any OpenAI-compatible server at base_url) or "openrouter" (cloud: prompts, including your code, leave the machine) |
| `base_url` | str | `"http://localhost:11434"` | Ollama or OpenAI-compatible server address |
| `models` | list[model] | `qwen3.5:latest` | models to use: names, or tables with name, weight and temperature |
| `temperature` | float | `0.8` | sampling temperature (per-model override possible) |
| `num_ctx` | int | `32768` | context window in tokens; also sizes the prompt budget |
| `max_tokens` | int | `8192` | answer token limit (doubled when thinking is on) |
| `max_answer_chars` | int | `0` | stop longer answers early; 0 = auto (2 x program + 8000) |
| `timeout` | float | `900.0` | seconds without data before a request fails |
| `concurrency` | int | `1` | parallel requests; match OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL |
| `think` | bool or none | none | ollama "think" flag for reasoning models; None = model default |
| `max_consecutive_errors` | int | `5` | stop the run when this many requests fail in a row; 0 = never |
| `keep_alive` | str | `"30m"` | how long Ollama keeps the model loaded between requests |
| `insights_model` | str or none | none | model for the lessons notebook; None = first model |
| `api_key_env` | str | `"OPENAI_API_KEY"` | environment variable holding the openai provider's key |
| `openrouter_key_env` | str | `"OPENROUTER_API_KEY"` | environment variable holding the OpenRouter key |
| `openrouter_key_file` | str | `"~/openrouter.txt"` | file holding the OpenRouter key, read when the environment variable is not set; keep it readable only by you (chmod 600) |
| `max_cost_usd` | float | `0.0` | stop the run once paid requests cost this much; 0 = no limit |

## `[[llm.models]]`

One model of the ensemble (a plain string sets only the name).

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | required | model name, e.g. "qwen3.5:latest" (Ollama) or "qwen/qwen3-coder" (OpenRouter) |
| `weight` | float | `1.0` | relative probability of picking this model per request |
| `temperature` | float or none | none | None: use llm.temperature |
| `provider` | str or none | none | "ollama", "openai" or "openrouter"; None: llm.provider |
| `base_url` | str or none | none | server of this model; None: the provider's default |

## `[search]`

The evolutionary search.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iterations` | int | `200` | model answers per run (fix-up retries not counted) |
| `max_minutes` | float | `0.0` | 0 = unlimited |
| `target_score` | float or none | none | stop when a program reaches this score |
| `islands` | int | `4` | independent sub-populations; iterations rotate over them |
| `migration_interval` | int | `40` | completed evaluations between ring migrations |
| `exploit_ratio` | float | `0.6` | parent = strong program of the island |
| `explore_ratio` | float | `0.25` | parent = random niche elite (diversity) |
| `repair_ratio` | float | `0.1` | parent = a recent failed attempt, asked to fix it |
| `fix_retries` | int | `1` | immediate LLM fix-up attempts after a crash or compile error |
| `rewrite_ratio` | float | `0.15` | ask for a full rewrite of the block instead of a diff |
| `bold_ratio` | float | `0.3` | ask for a substantially different approach |
| `tune_ratio` | float | `0.15` | ask to expose constants and SWEEP them (if sweeps are on) |
| `adaptive` | bool | `true` | learn style/edit weights from results (ratios above are priors) |
| `num_inspirations` | int | `2` | other strong programs shown in each prompt |
| `journal_lines` | int | `12` | recent attempts shown per prompt |
| `insights_interval` | int | `20` | completed evaluations between lessons-notebook updates; 0 = off |
| `sweep_budget` | int | `16` | max engine-run variants per LLM-proposed SWEEP; 0 = sweeps off |
| `seed` | int | `0` | random seed of the search decisions |
| `features` | list[feature] | `code_size` | MAP-Elites axes; a program competes only with programs in its own cell |

## `[[search.features]]`

One MAP-Elites axis.

| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | required | evaluator feature name, or the builtin code_size |
| `min` | float | required | lower end of the axis (smaller values go to the first bin) |
| `max` | float | required | upper end of the axis (larger values go to the last bin) |
| `bins` | int | `6` | number of bins |
| `log` | bool | `false` | bin on a logarithmic scale |
